{"results": [
  {"n": "G1", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–5 show the 3D scene rendered cleanly in Chrome with no blank screen or errors.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "G2", "evidence": "Screenshots 2–5 demonstrate camera orbiting and zooming, and `OrbitControls` restricts `maxPolarAngle = Math.PI * 0.465` and `maxDistance = 15.5`, preventing the camera from going below the ground or outside the tablecloth (radius 17).", "pass": true},
  {"n": "G3", "evidence": "After initial procedural texture generation, the render loop only draws ~50 low-poly meshes, one `InstancedMesh`, one `Points` cloud, two shadow maps (2048 and 1024), and lightweight `UnrealBloomPass`/`BokehPass`, easily running above 30 fps on integrated graphics.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "1", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–5 show an on-screen UI bar at the bottom with text ('Drag to orbit · Scroll to zoom') and two interactive buttons ('Macro DoF: ON' and 'Hero Angle').", "pass": false},
  {"n": "2", "evidence": "In the `animate()` function, only `controls.update()` and camera resetting run; there is no environmental motion (no dripping syrup or rising steam) running on load.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "3", "evidence": "Screenshot 1 matches the reference photo's close-up, slightly elevated camera angle with the French toast stack centered on the dark plate.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "4", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–3 show three thick slices of French toast stacked and slightly rotated/offset relative to each other, matching the reference photo.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "5", "evidence": "Screenshots 1 and 4 show banana slices on top, peeking from between the layers, and resting on the plate around the stack, though several heavily clip into the toast.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "6", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–4 show blueberries clustered on top of the stack and scattered around the base on the plate.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "7", "evidence": "Screenshots 1 and 5 show the stack resting on a dark round plate set on a grey-brown linen surface, although a black background void is visible above the cloth horizon.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "8", "evidence": "Screenshots 1 and 4 show white specks scattered over the plate and lightly on the toast, though they look like coarse white dots rather than fine powder.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "9", "evidence": "In Screenshots 1–4, the toast slices have uniform, repetitive fluted edges resembling scalloped plastic cookies or tart shells rather than bread with a natural rounded crust and soft cut edges.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "10", "evidence": "Screenshots 1 and 4 show round banana discs with a faint dark seeded pattern in the center.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "11", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–4 show round blueberries of slightly varying sizes (`r: 0.250` to `0.315` in `berryPlacements`) with sculpted 5-pointed crowns visible on top.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "12", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–3 and 5 show the toast slices and fruit resting on each other and the plate with nothing floating in mid-air.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "13", "evidence": "When orbited in Screenshots 2, 3, and 5, the toast, plate, and cloth are solid meshes without holes or missing faces, though the far edge of the finite tablecloth plane is visible against black space in Screenshots 1–3 and 5.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "14", "evidence": "In `keyLight.position.set(-5.2, 8.4, 5.4)`, the main light comes from the front-left rather than behind-left as in the photo, and Screenshot 1 lacks the bright warm window highlights on the syrup.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "15", "evidence": "In Screenshot 1, despite `BokehPass` being active (`maxblur: 0.0065`), the back rim of the plate and the tablecloth horizon remain nearly sharp rather than softly blurred as in the reference photo.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "16", "evidence": "Screenshots 1 and 4 show harsh, dark grey rings/halos around the banana slices (caused by `MeshPhysicalMaterial` transmission on `syrupMat` rendering dark silhouettes) instead of natural soft contact shadows.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "17", "evidence": "In Screenshot 1, the strip at the very top of the frame above the tablecloth is almost pure black (`#161412` background).", "pass": false},
  {"n": "18", "evidence": "In Screenshots 1 and 3, the syrup rivulets on the toast crust look like dark, opaque brown ridges and the puddles on the plate look like flat reddish-brown shapes, lacking glossy translucent amber appearance and bright specular highlights.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "19", "evidence": "In Screenshots 1–4, the toast surfaces are smooth and plastic-like with uniform pale yellow centers and striped brown scalloped sides, showing no porous bread crumb or realistic uneven caramelisation.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "20", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–4 show blueberries with a mottled, high-contrast blotchy blue-and-white texture that reads as noisy paint rather than a natural dusty matte bloom with soft highlights.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "21", "evidence": "In Screenshots 1 and 4, the banana slices look flat, chalky, and matte grey-beige with dark intersecting rings, lacking a moist or slightly translucent appearance.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "22", "evidence": "In Screenshot 1, the plate has a dark sheen, though a harsh concentric ring artifact is visible on its floor, and the cloth in Screenshots 1–3 and 5 looks like a blurry grey noise plane rather than clearly woven fabric.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "23", "evidence": "Screenshot 5 confirms that the plate and tablecloth lie flat and level on the horizontal plane with no unintended tilt.", "pass": true},
  {"n": "24", "evidence": "Inspection of `addCrustSyrupRivulets` and `animate()` shows the syrup meshes are completely static with no dripping or running animation.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "25", "evidence": "Inspection of the HTML source and screenshots shows no steam or warm haze particle system or shader in the scene.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "26", "evidence": "There is no environmental motion implemented in `animate()` at all.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "27", "evidence": "In Screenshots 1 and 4, adjacent blueberries share the exact same `berryTex` UV mapping, making identical blotchy white-and-blue texture patterns clearly visible on neighboring berries.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "28", "evidence": "Screenshots 1–4 show severe geometry clipping: banana slices on top and between the layers intersect directly through the toast surfaces, and blueberries clip into the toast edges in Screenshot 2.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "29", "evidence": "In Screenshots 1–5, the sugar on the plate consists of distinct, oversized, uniform bright white dots/pebbles (`sugarInstanced` icosahedrons) rather than reading as fine powder.", "pass": false},
  {"n": "30", "evidence": "Screenshot 1 looks unmistakably like stylized, low-realism 3D computer graphics—with scalloped plastic-looking toast, blotchy berries, severe banana clipping, and a bottom UI bar—and could not pass for the reference photo.", "pass": false}
]}
